dedupe_keys.name: anam burkina faso climatological data and climate bulletins

description: The climatology service of the National Meteorology Agency of Burkina Faso (ANAM) supplies weather and climate variables such as temperature, rainfall, wind and humidity from its observation network, and issues intra-seasonal and seasonal forecasts. ANAM is the national provider of climatological data, available at daily, monthly, seasonal or annual time scales according to users' needs, and it also issues certified weather records for a given date and place. Its products include the seasonal forecast bulletin on the agro-hydro-climatic features of the rainy season, the annual state of the climate report, a monthly climate bulletin, a drought monitoring bulletin on rainfall deficits, soil moisture and water resources, a climate and health bulletin, a water and energy bulletin and heat wave bulletins. The site also links an interactive map, satellite images, station data exchange through wis2box, a data request form and the FANFAR flood alert portal. Bulletins are free to read online; station data is supplied on request, and cost and licence terms were not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the site is in French, and detailed data needs a request. Coverage is Burkina Faso. It supports hazard exposure and climate adaptation analysis of drought, heat and floods for water, energy and transport infrastructure; related records are the NEA Singapore real-time weather readings and the Mexico Atlas Nacional de Riesgos.
